g.text: LynchzDEV: 🎵 Update scene: Resounding Storm by Punishing Gray Raven +++ LynchzDEV: 🎵 Update scene: Good night, Terra by Lappy +++ LynchzDEV: 🎵 Update scene: Destiny by Lucia +++ mission-control: feat(jobs): survive server restarts — children write logs via direct fd (no pipes), boot adopts orphaned running jobs (pid watch, log-marker settle), pid-based kill; redaction moves to serving time +++ mission-control: feat(jobs): auto codex cross-review when a glm job lands with a diff — gated on codex auth, one review per thread, chained into the source thread +++ mission-control: test: follow binary-resolution change — PATH prefix assertion, basename-keyed command mock +++ LynchzDEV: 🎵 Update scene: Resounding Storm by Punishing Gray Raven +++ LynchzDEV: 🎵 Update scene: Good night, Terra by Lappy +++ LynchzDEV: 🎵 Update scene: Destiny by Lucia +++ mission-control: feat(jobs): survive server restarts — children write logs via direct fd (no pipes), boot adopts orphaned running jobs (pid watch, log-marker settle), pid-based kill; redaction moves to serving time +++ mission-control: feat(jobs): auto codex cross-review when a glm job lands with a diff — gated on codex auth, one review per thread, chained into the source thread +++ mission-control: test: follow binary-resolution change — PATH prefix assertion, basename-keyed command mock +++
